pick.name: Cloudflare Workers (createMcpHandler) + Workers OAuth Provider
pick.what: Stateless Streamable-HTTP MCP on Workers; OAuthAuthorizationServer + OAuthResourceServer
pick.why: Free-tier edge hosting with a built-in OAuth 2.1 flow MCP clients expect
pick.free_limits: Workers Free: 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/request, 128 MB, 50 subrequests, 5 cron triggers, 100 Workers. Durable Object availability on Free not shown on limits page (check DO pricing page)

candidates.name: Hono + @hono/mcp

decision: Workers gives free hosting plus a ready OAuth server for MCP clients. Mount @hono/mcp in the main API instead when the MCP tools are thin wrappers over existing endpoints.
